description: Unit of the object-list lateral code (slot 44|12, summaries 0x192 / 0x194 word 1, 0x680): 0.015 m per code, 66.7 codes per metre. Independent estimates in codes per metre, and the replay of the fused profile with the corrected lateral units. Set 1 = 700 one-minute segments, set 2 = 114 segments of other drives, 'original logs' = 13 logs decoded with the public decoder.

acc_lateral_code_per_object_list_code.note: the ACC target lateral (0x237, 12 bits, zero code 2000) is a centimetre field; the summary lateral of the same target is in object-list codes

crossing_objects_position_codes_per_velo.note: objects with motion code 3 / 4 on straight road: change of the lateral code over the window against the integral of the lateral-velocity code (74|10, 0.15 m/s per code). 10.0 means 0.015 m per code; 1/64 m would give 9.6

stationary_cars_under_ego_rotation.note: stationary vehicles while ego turns at a steady yaw rate (gyro lag 0.08 s): lateral code change against the rotation of the object's position; track bootstrap interval

lane_cells_vs_camera_lane_width.note: 0x85 lane-cell offsets (centimetre field, zero code 2000) against openpilot's lane lines: ego-lane width 348 codes against 3.41 m

lane_peaks_codes_per_3p66_m_lane.note: adjacent-lane peaks of moving highway traffic (lane_peaks.json); lane widths vary

fused_replay_with_corrected_lateral_unit.note: 34 replay drives, limits fixed before the run: object-list lateral 0.015 m per code and the 12-bit ACC lateral, against the same profile with the previous lateral conversions
